title: Vietnamese Cured Fish Pilaf
description: A keto-friendly dish that combines the flavors of Vietnam with the comfort of pilaf. This recipe is perfect for a low-carb diet.

ingredients.name: Pilaf
ingredients.notes: made with cauliflower and coconut flour

instructions: In a large skillet, heat coconut oil over medium-high heat.
Add fish pieces and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Transfer fish to a baking dish and bake for 8-10 minutes or until cooked through.
In the same skillet, add diced pork and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add fish sauce and stir to combine.
Add pilaf to the skillet and stir to combine with pork and fish sauce mixture.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until pilaf is well coated.
Serve pilaf mixture over fish and garnish with chopped green onions.
